t: An open-source four-channel oscilloscope that streams every sample to your computer.
steps: Order the TS-USB4 box or the TS-PCIe card from Crowd Supply.
Buy a set of passive scope probes, which are sold separately.
Check your computer for a Thunderbolt or USB4 port, or a free PCIe x4 slot.
Follow the official Getting Started guide to install the ThunderScope driver for Windows, Linux, or macOS.
Install ngscopeclient, the free scope app.
Connect the scope and add it as an instrument in ngscopeclient.
Probe a blinking LED circuit and adjust the time and voltage scales until the wave looks steady.
